description: This file defines the EnvelopeADSR class, a subclass of SynthUnit, implementing a simple ADSR envelope generator with linear ramps and configurable attack, decay, sustain, and release times.

classes.name: EnvelopeADSR
classes.description: A class implementing an ADSR (Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release) envelope with linear ramps, used in sound synthesis.

methods.name: setAttackTime
methods.description: Sets the attack time, ensuring minimum time for ramp up.

methods.name: setDecayTime
methods.description: Sets the decay time, ensuring minimum time for ramp down.

methods.name: setReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets the release time, ensuring minimum duration for ramp down.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Starts the attack phase of the envelope.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Starts the release phase of the envelope.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Computes the current envelope value based on the phase.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the envelope has finished releasing.
